title: Bronze Legion Rush
description: Adds Bronze, Colosseum, Legionnaires and Best Helmet
body:
Overview

A Minecraft mod that brings the ancient Roman Legion to your world! Face waves of deadly legionnaires inside the Colosseum, from basic soldiers to massive Juggernauts with chain flails. Mine bronze ore and craft powerful armor to survive the assault!


Features

4 types of legionnaires: Basic (40 HP), Cavalry on horses, Heavy armored (100 HP), and massive Juggernauts (500 HP mini-bosses)

10-wave Legion raids that only start inside the Colosseum structure

Chain flail attack - Juggernauts can attack players from up to 10 blocks away

Bronze ore generation throughout the world

Bronze armor and weapons - helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, sword, pickaxe, and axe
Legion Recognition helmet - Ultimate reward with max protection, fire resistance, blast protection, and projectile protection

How to Use

Create a Colosseum: /colosseum create

Enter the Colosseum and start the raid: /legion start

Survive all 10 waves to earn the Legion Recognition helmet!

Check your progress: /legion status

Leave the raid if needed: /legion leave

Tips & Tricks

Bring your best armor before starting a raid!

Heavy Legionnaires spawn from wave 5, Cavalry from wave 3, and Juggernauts from wave 8

The final reward has all protection types at level 10 - no one can knock your head off!

Mine bronze ore inside the Colosseum for extra loot

Known Limitations

Raids only work when standing inside a Colosseum structure

Must be in the Colosseum to be attacked by the Legion
